features.quote: stone basins ... conical holes. The upper diameter ... about 20 cm

notes: The 20-25 'stone basins' are large stones with conical holes c. 20 cm across (probably mortars); recorded only for traceability with pool_def no. No pit or grave in this entry (the Qa'un cemetery is a separate entry, Site 4). Data block 'Cisterns: none' recorded as a C2 absence. No plan.
